sets.title: Tense and Aspect Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct aspect and tense for each context
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильное время и вид глагола

items.prompt: Сейчас она _____ обед. (She is cooking dinner right now.)
items.promptEnglish: She is cooking dinner right now.
items.hint: Сейчас = right now. Only imperfective has a true present tense.
items.explanation: Present tense can only be imperfective: готовит. Perfective has no present form.

items.prompt: Завтра он _____ этот отчёт. (Tomorrow he will finish this report.)
items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow he will finish this report.
items.hint: Completed result in the future uses perfective.
items.explanation: Single completed result in future uses perfective: напишет.

items.prompt: Вчера мы долго _____ этот вопрос. (Yesterday we discussed this issue for a long time.)
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday we discussed this issue for a long time.
items.hint: Долго emphasizes duration in the past.
items.explanation: Duration (долго) in the past requires imperfective: обсуждали.

items.prompt: Каждую субботу мы _____ в кино. (Every Saturday we go to the movies.)
items.promptEnglish: Every Saturday we go to the movies.
items.explanation: Habitual present action uses imperfective: ходим.

items.prompt: Он уже _____ домашнее задание. (He has already done his homework.)
items.promptEnglish: He has already done his homework.
items.explanation: Result marker 'уже' requires perfective past: сделал.

items.prompt: Завтра весь день я _____ для экзамена. (Tomorrow I'll be studying for the exam all day.)
items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow I'll be studying for the exam all day.
items.hint: Extended future activity (весь день) = imperfective future.
items.explanation: Extended duration in the future (весь день) uses imperfective future: буду готовиться.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ письмо два часа. (He wrote/was writing the letter for two hours - process.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He was writing the letter for two hours (process).
minimalPairs.explanation: Duration (два часа) emphasizes the process, requiring imperfective past: писал.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ письмо за два часа. (He wrote the letter in two hours - result within timeframe.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He wrote the letter in two hours (completed within timeframe).
minimalPairs.explanation: Completed within a timeframe (за два часа) requires perfective: написал.

minimalPairs.context: Завтра я _____ эту книгу. (process, extended future activity)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Tomorrow I'll be reading this book (extended activity).
minimalPairs.explanation: Extended future activity without emphasis on completion uses imperfective future: буду читать.

minimalPairs.context: Завтра я обязательно _____ эту книгу. (will definitely finish it)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Tomorrow I'll definitely finish this book.
minimalPairs.explanation: Definite completion (обязательно + finish) uses perfective future: прочитаю.

sets.title: Sort and Correct
sets.description: Sort verb forms by tense and fix aspect mistakes
sets.descriptionRussian: Рассортируйте глаголы по временам и исправьте ошибки

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these verb forms: Past, Present, or Future?

errorCorrection.hint: Сейчас (right now) = present tense. Perfective verbs have no true present.
errorCorrection.explanation: Прочитает looks like present tense but is actually perfective future. For 'right now,' use imperfective present: читает.

errorCorrection.hint: Вчера (yesterday) requires past tense, not future.
errorCorrection.explanation: Past tense is needed with 'вчера': готовила (imperfective past for process) or приготовила (perfective past for result).

errorCorrection.hint: Каждое утро (every morning) = habitual action. Which aspect for habits?
errorCorrection.explanation: Habitual actions (каждое утро) require imperfective: пил, not perfective выпил.

errorCorrection.sentence: Завтра я долго сделаю домашнее задание.
errorCorrection.hint: Долго (for a long time) emphasizes process/duration, which needs imperfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: Duration marker 'долго' in future requires imperfective future: буду делать, not perfective сделаю.

items.prompt: What tense does the perfective present form actually express?
items.hint: Perfective verbs have no true present. Their 'present' form means something else.
items.explanation: The conjugated form of a perfective verb (прочитаю, напишу) is actually future tense, not present.

items.prompt: Наконец он _____ решение. (He finally made a decision.)
items.hint: Наконец (finally) = achieved result in the past.
items.explanation: Result marker 'наконец' + past context requires perfective past: принял.

items.prompt: Она часто _____ об этом. (She often thinks about this.)
items.hint: Часто (often) + present context = habitual imperfective present.
items.explanation: Habitual present action (часто) uses imperfective present: думает.

sets.title: Patterns and Building
sets.description: Recognize signal words and build sentences
sets.descriptionRussian: Распознайте сигнальные слова и постройте предложения

patternRecognition.sentence: долго, часто, обычно, каждый день, всегда
patternRecognition.question: What aspect do these signal words typically require?
patternRecognition.explanation: These words signal duration, repetition, or habit, all of which require imperfective aspect.

patternRecognition.sentence: уже, вдруг, наконец, сразу, за час
patternRecognition.question: What aspect do these signal words typically require?
patternRecognition.explanation: These words signal completion, suddenness, or result within a timeframe, requiring perfective aspect.

patternRecognition.question: These look like present tense conjugations, but what tense do they actually express?
patternRecognition.explanation: These are perfective verbs. Perfective has no present tense. Their conjugated forms express future: прочитаю = I will read (and finish).

blanks: Обычно она _____ на работу на метро. (She usually goes to work by metro.)
Вчера он наконец _____ новую работу. (Yesterday he finally found a new job.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Signal words determine tense and aspect
hints: Наконец (finally) = completed result in past. Which form?
explanations: Habitual present (обычно) uses imperfective present: ездит.
Achieved result (наконец) uses perfective past: нашёл.

translation.english: She is writing a letter right now.
translation.hint: right now = сейчас, present tense, only imperfective has present: пишет
translation.grammarFocus: Only imperfective has a true present tense

translation.english: Tomorrow I will finish this project.
translation.hint: finish = completed result in future = perfective future: закончу
every day = каждый день, habitual = imperfective present: читает

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All tenses and aspects in one round
sets.descriptionRussian: Все времена и виды в одном раунде

items.prompt: How many tenses does imperfective aspect have?
items.hint: Imperfective is the 'full' aspect with all tenses.
items.explanation: Imperfective has all 3 tenses: past (читал), present (читаю), future (буду читать).

items.prompt: Я _____ этот фильм, не мешай. (I'm watching this movie, don't bother me.)
items.promptEnglish: I'm watching this movie, don't bother me.
items.hint: Action happening right now = present tense = imperfective only.
items.explanation: Action in progress right now uses imperfective present: смотрю.

items.prompt: Она _____ ужин и сразу легла спать. (She ate dinner and immediately went to bed.)
items.promptEnglish: She ate dinner and immediately went to bed.
items.hint: Completed action followed by the next (сразу) = perfective.
items.explanation: Completed action with immediate next step (сразу) uses perfective: поужинала.

errorCorrection.hint: Каждый день = habitual present. Habitual actions need imperfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: Habitual present (каждый день) requires imperfective present: готовит, not perfective future приготовит.

errorCorrection.hint: Вдруг (suddenly) signals a sudden realization, a single completed event.
errorCorrection.explanation: Sudden event (вдруг) requires perfective: понял, not imperfective понимал.

errorCorrection.hint: Сейчас = right now. Perfective has no present tense; решат is future.
errorCorrection.explanation: Сейчас requires present tense, which only exists for imperfective: решают. Решат is perfective future, not present.
